title: Telegram AI chat bot
description: A Telegram bot that runs on Neon Functions, answers messages through AI Gateway, and stores the conversation in Postgres.

environment.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
environment.description: The bot token from @BotFather, which the function uses to reply to messages.

environment.name: TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET
environment.description: A random secret of letters, digits, _ and - that the function uses to verify that incoming requests come from Telegram.
